intent_sections.title: Search Console Query Flow Verified
intent_sections.summary: The operator can enter a query, watch the console move from idle to loading, and read a ranked list of matches. Ranking order, the states the operator can tell apart, and the narrow viewport floor were each verified against a captured artifact.

intent_sections.title: Which Count the Result Summary Reads
intent_sections.summary: The result summary can read the total the boundary reports for the whole corpus, or the number of rows on the page the operator is looking at. The two disagree whenever the corpus is larger than one page, and nobody has chosen yet.

options.impact: The summary reports the whole corpus match count, which matches what an operator expects from a search tool, and the page shows a subset of it.
The summary reports what is on screen, which never disagrees with the visible rows but understates the corpus and reads as a bug on a large search.
